blocks.demandScenarioDescription: Secondary markets work when Courtyard by Marriott's product and fee load clear local ADR reality; diligence source-market seasonality.

blocks.title: Highway & Interstate Transient
blocks.body: Not a Fit
blocks.demandScenarioDescription: Highway / interstate limited-service economics generally sit outside Courtyard by Marriott's product and fee structure.

blocks.title: Resort & Coastal Leisure
blocks.body: Limited Fit
blocks.demandScenarioDescription: Leisure resort fit depends on whether Courtyard by Marriott's service model matches resort operating complexity.
